name: Mexico City

plates.name: Current design (2016)
plates.fact: Mexico City's everyday plate is white with black characters, a maroon 'Ciudad de México' legend beside the city and SEMOVI shields, and a QR code in the corner.

plates.name: World Cup 2026 commemorative
plates.fact: Only 60,000 were made, in black, white and yellow versions with an axolotl in a feather headdress, hummingbirds, flowers and the Sun Stone.

plates.name: Hybrid and electric vehicles
plates.fact: SEMOVI issues a separate plate set for hybrid and electric cars.

plates.name: Antique cars (auto antiguo)
plates.fact: The plate shows an old car and the words 'auto antiguo'.

plates.name: Drivers with disabilities
plates.fact: Both plates carry the international disability symbol.

about: Mexico City plates to hunt, from the state's own sources on 2026-10-26. Not rated yet: every plate is worth the same.

sources.title: State, provincial and territorial licensing agencies, and the plates' sponsors
